items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Charles Thomas was his name, we called him Ollie Popper. He was playing bass and Charlie Hamilton on piano and I was on guitar and Brady was on drums.

ctx.x: Was George Lewis old fashioned and good boy with that old time in him?

Yeah, he was old fashioned. And you see like this boy played with Thomas would play with Celestan. All that, he was more modern than all of them because he couldn't read but he was nice coming up, but all of them, they come back and shawky, Banana brought back that. René used to teach shawky, you understand, you didn't know that did you?
